findings.mechanism: The arrival word is the carrier, the unresolved bringing role and compelling branch add pressure, Rabbuka triggers sovereign compulsion, and the host and ranks make the forced presentation visible.
findings.reader_payoff: The scene can be felt as the moment when what is absent becomes unavoidable presence.
findings.containment: This is exploratory and attributed; unresolved B004 receives no gloss or facet, and the pressure does not replace the active intransitive arrival with a causative parsing.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace agrees with the supplied focus word indices and roots, but its compelling branch is partly unresolved and its source is legacy_unbound; it is retained as an exploratory attributed reading.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus jāʾa form is the supplied carrier for the HFT role of bringing or presenting.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Rabbuka independently supplies the sovereign source of unavoidable presentation.
branch_activations.activation: The attributed bringing role meets sovereign arrival, adding a presentation horizon without assigning a gloss to unresolved B004.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The advent can expose presences that are brought into view.
branch_activations.boundary: B004 is unresolved in the packet, so no lexical gloss or facet is asserted.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus jāʾa form carries the supplied driving or compelling pressure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Sovereign Rabbuka and ordered ranks independently supply the authority and arrangement into which presences are driven.
branch_activations.activation: Compelling pressure meets sovereign ordered presence, changing arrival into an unavoidable presentation horizon while remaining secondary to the active form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The event can gather all presences into unavoidable ordered display.
branch_activations.boundary: This is form-distant pressure, not a claim that the local verb is causative.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: Rabbuka carries the supplied ownership and command authority.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The arrival and ranked deployment independently show the authority's source and ordered result.
branch_activations.activation: Authority meets presentation pressure, making the sovereign subject the source of the unavoidable display.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Sovereign authority supplies the horizon of compulsory presentation.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not add a new divine title or causal grammar.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Birden çok ögeyi düz bir çizgi üzerinde yan yana yerleştirme ya da bu biçimde düzenlenmiş olma.
branch_activations.carrier: The doubled ṣaffan forms carry ordered placement in ranks.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The angelic collective independently supplies the presences being arranged.
branch_activations.activation: Ranked placement meets the attendant host, making presentation visibly ordered rather than merely forced.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What is presented appears in assigned ranks.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not infer a fixed order beyond the supplied formation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ad, ilahi haber veya buyruk ileten haberci varlığı belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-malaku carries the supplied angelic-host attendant image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The repeated ranks independently give the attendants a visible deployment.
branch_activations.activation: The host meets ordered presentation, becoming the visible attendant body of the compulsory horizon.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The angelic host is presented as an ordered attendant presence.
branch_activations.boundary: The local angelic identity and subordinate role remain bounded.

findings.title: rows and level field
findings.claim: The doubled rank expression can evoke both an array and the level field that exposes every rank.
findings.mechanism: The repeated ṣaffan is the carrier, its ordinary row facet and the supplied smooth-ground facet are the paired triggers, and their contact makes the doubled geometry simultaneous.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see ranks aligned across a uniformly exposed field without losing the ordinary row meaning.
findings.containment: This is exploratory and attributed; the level-field pressure does not replace ordinary rows or assert literal ground in the scene.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supplies matching focus coordinates for both row occurrences and the level-field branch, but its legacy_unbound exploratory provenance requires attribution.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus jāʾa form carries the supplied advent moment in which the double geometry appears.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The two rank occurrences independently supply the spatial field of the scene.
branch_activations.activation: The advent moment meets the repeated geometry, locating the array and exposed field together.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The leveled geometry is perceived at the moment of advent.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not alter the ordinary lexical meaning of arrival.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Birden çok ögeyi düz bir çizgi üzerinde yan yana yerleştirme ya da bu biçimde düzenlenmiş olma.
branch_activations.carrier: The doubled ṣaffan forms carry straight aligned ranks.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The arrival event independently locates those ranks in the focus scene.
branch_activations.activation: Rows meet the advent, making the formation the ordinary visible geometry.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The angels stand in an array whose alignment is fully exposed.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary row reading remains recoverable.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yüzeyi düz ve pürüzsüz olan arazi ya da geniş düzlük.
branch_activations.carrier: The doubled ṣaffan forms carry the packet's smooth, level-ground image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The arrival event independently supplies the scene in which no elevation interrupts the view.
branch_activations.activation: The level-field pressure meets the repeated row carrier, projecting aligned ranks across an exposed horizon.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The array can simultaneously evoke a uniformly level field.
branch_activations.boundary: This attributed branch pressure is an image, not a claim that the verse literally names ground.
